Author: dajoey
Name: LazyFoodBuff
Description: Auto-eats food in combat duties with per-job selection, auto-select based on best stats, and a low-time warning.
Punchline: Never forget to eat your food again.
Changelog: v0.1.0.0 - Initial release. Auto-eats food in combat duties (dungeons, raids, trials, alliance raids, criterion, variant). Per-job food selection or auto-select by best stats for your job, optional fallback to auto-select, refresh-before-expiry, and a low-time chat warning. Use /lazyfoodbuff.
